beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow the proposed institutions alongside the power they would themselves acquire.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book does not establish that these arrangements will inevitably appear.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks what societies would need to build if sustained judgment is to remain possible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to examine attention as a shared institutional responsibility, not merely a private resource.
